title: A part sale's card keeps one Sales Representative field and no +
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • You are signed in as a user with the "Admin" role at {Location-A}.
    For example: {Location-A} is Staging Heavy Duty - 9919.
  • Two active staff members at {Location-A} have their "Sales Representative" switch on: {Sales-rep-A} and {Sales-rep-B}.
    For example: {Sales-rep-A} is ZZAUTOTEST Ann Able and {Sales-rep-B} is ZZAUTOTEST Ben Able.
  • Customer {Customer-A} has no sales representative.
    For example: {Customer-A} is ZZAUTOTEST SSR Fleet.
  • Part sale {Part-sale-1} for {Customer-A} is open and not invoiced.
    For example: {Part-sale-1} is P-30001.
  • Starting screen: {Part-sale-1} is open in a desktop browser at least 1024 px wide.
  • If any record above is missing, mark this test Blocked: "setup not done".
custom_steps:
1. Hover over the part sale's Sales Representative field.
  2. Click the field and pick {Sales-rep-A}.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 1: there is one Sales Representative field and no + button beside it.
  • Step 2: the field reads {Sales-rep-A}; still no + and no remove x.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-10890; story SV-11266 (Story 2, Give a work order a separate Labor and Parts representative); story SV-11268 (Story 4, Give a customer default representatives); PRD "Splitting Sales Representatives", Confluence 919928833, version 8 (14 Oct 2026, Chris Ward), S2-N2, S4-R32, read 19 Oct 2026. Claude design canvas "Splitting Sales Representatives" (https://claude.ai/artifact/8MHqwyffAYtqZ6EccS5RUm), pages 1 and 2 (cited by the story), export read 19 Oct 2026, used for on-screen labels; the look itself is checked in the "Design — how it looks" cases. Source-verified 19 October 2026. The build is not yet available to check this case against.

The part sale's Sales Representative field comes from Part Sales Update v1 (SV-10266). If that is not on the build being tested, mark this case Blocked and say so.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S2-N2: “A part sale's card has no + button. A part sale keeps one Sales Representative field.”
  • S4-R32: “Picking a person, or "Unassigned", on a work order or part sale changes only that work order or part sale, never its customer.”
